for i in start_idxs:
    print('start idx', i, 'event', indexed[i])

target_idxs = [i for i,e in enumerate(indexed) if e[1]==tgt]
print('Target events (receiver=={}): count {}'.format(tgt, len(target_idxs)))
for i in target_idxs:
    print('target idx', i, 'event', indexed[i])

visited = set()
prev = dict()  # prev[event_idx] = previous_event_idx
q = deque()
for s in start_idxs:
    q.append(s)
    visited.add(s)
    prev[s] = None
found_path = None

while q:

    u,v,t = indexed[cur]

        if t2>t and t2 - t <= max_delay:
            if nxt not in visited:
                visited.add(nxt)
                prev[nxt] = cur
                q.append(nxt)

if found_path is None:
    print('No time-respecting path found under constraints')
else:

    path = []
    cur = found_path
    while cur is not None:
        path.append((cur, indexed[cur]))
        cur = prev[cur]

# We'll compute earliest time that each node can be 'informed' starting from src at any of its send times.

start, end = 13283, 32483
src, tgt = 1885, 1460
max_delay = 600

ev_win = [(u,v,t) for (u,v,t) in events if start <= t <= end]
indexed = sorted(ev_win, key=lambda x:x[2])
from collections import defaultdict, deque
sender_map = defaultdict(list)
for i,e in enumerate(indexed):
    u,v,t = e
    sender_map[u].append(i)

# find starts
start_idxs = [i for i,e in enumerate(indexed) if e[0]==src]
# BFS
visited=set(); prev=dict(); q=deque()
for s in start_idxs:
    visited.add(s); prev[s]=None; q.append(s)
found=None
while q:
    cur=q.popleft()
    u,v,t = indexed[cur]
    if v==tgt:
        found=cur; break
    for nxt in sender_map.get(v,[]):
        u2,v2,t2=indexed[nxt]
        if t2>t and t2-t<=max_delay and nxt not in visited:
            visited.add(nxt); prev[nxt]=cur; q.append(nxt)

if found is None:
    print('NO_PATH')
else:
    path=[]; cur=found
    while cur is not None:
        path.append(indexed[cur]); cur=prev[cur]
    path.reverse()
    print('TIME-RESPECTING PATH FOUND:')
    total_hops=len(path)
    print('HOPS:', total_hops)
    for i,(u,v,t) in enumerate(path):
        print(i, (u,v,t))
        if i>0:
            prev_t = path[i-1][2]

# static directed reachability ignoring time
graph = defaultdict(set)
for u,v,t in ev_win:
    graph[u].add(v)
# BFS static
vis=set([src]); dq=[src]
while dq:
    n=dq.pop(0)
    for nb in graph.get(n,[]):
        if nb not in vis:
            vis.add(nb); dq.append(nb)

print('Static directed reachability from {} includes {}: {}'.format(src, tgt, tgt in vis))

# Degrees (out-degree and in-degree) in window for nodes in the time path
if found is not None:
    nodes_in_path = set()
    for u,v,t in path:
        nodes_in_path.add(u); nodes_in_path.add(v)

        outdeg[u]+=1; indeg[v]+=1
    print('Node degrees in window (in,out) for nodes in path:')
    for n in sorted(nodes_in_path):
        print(n, indeg.get(n,0), outdeg.get(n,0))

# Also show events involving nodes in path for context
if found is not None:
    print('All events among nodes in path (chronological):')
    nodes=nodes_in_path
    for (u,v,t) in sorted([e for e in ev_win if e[0] in nodes and e[1] in nodes], key=lambda x:x[2]):
        print((u,v,t))
